Subject: Private MAP orientation: VPN/Networking + IAM/KMS owner alignment

Hi Morgan / Acme team —

Thanks again for taking time to kick off the Private deployment MAP. The goal for this thread is to align on owners for networking/VPN, IAM, and KMS so we can finalize a short evaluation plan and firm up the close timeline. High-level asks below: 

1) Please confirm who on your side will own: 
   - VPN / network connectivity (cert exchange, firewall rules, BGP if needed)
   - IAM (service accounts, SSO mappings, role lists)
   - KMS / key management for model keys and customer secrets

2) Evaluation week: we propose the week of Apr 8 — objectives: baseline perf, KV caching smoke tests, and an auth flow end-to-end. Can you confirm availability?

3) Deliverables & deadlines (draft):
   - Network topology draft (shared) — Mar 28
   - IAM role matrix — Apr 3
   - KMS integration checklist — Apr 5

I attached a short MAP checklist and a topology draft to help. Once owners are confirmed we’ll assign specific action items in the MAP and set a short cadence (twice weekly 30m) during the eval window. 

Action: please reply with owner names and any constraints by EOD Mon (Mar 27).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Soojin — thanks for the clear kickoff. Quick answers from our side: 

- Network / VPN owner: Morgan Lee (me) — I will own cert exchange and firewall rule coordination.
- IAM owner: Priya Shah (cc'd) — Priya will handle role mappings and SSO integration.
- KMS owner: Acme Infra (infra@acme.com) — we will nominate an infra lead by next week.

Evaluation week Apr 8 works for us, but our infra team has a planned maintenance window Apr 10–11. If possible, let's aim for Apr 8–9 with a follow-up on Apr 12 for any remaining tests.

Link to our internal onboarding doc: https://acme.example.com/wiki/redwood-onboard (internal)

I'll ask infra to share a short public IP list and the SAML entity metadata by Mon.

Regards,
Morgan
Director, Cloud Infrastructure — Acme Corporation

- Revised evaluation window: Apr 8–9 primary tests, Apr 12 catch-up for infra maintenance.

I updated the MAP workbook with the dates and tentative owners (attached). Ben — please add HSM requirement options to the KMS checklist; Neha, if you can draft the KMS runbook we can circulate to Acme infra.

If that all looks good I’ll schedule the first 30m sync for Apr 2 to review the role matrix and the topology.
